metadata.case_name: CHEN HSUEH CHEN v. TAM WAI CHUN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Machine operator in a zip factory (operating a zip cutting machine)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Piece work at home for the same factory

injuries.description: serious injuries to her left foot; the ankle being degloved.
source: serious injuries to her left foot; the ankle being degloved.
the tissue between the heel bone (the calcaneus) and the outer skin of the sole of the heel was permanently removed.
the area of the heel where the bone was exposed has been the subject of several skin grafting operations and that the bone is now fully covered by the resulting skin grafts.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of ankle or foot

injuries.description: fracture of the medial malleolus of the right ankle
injuries.body_part: medial malleolus of the right ankle
source: fracture of the medial malleolus of the right ankle
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: fracture of the second and third metatarsal
source: fracture of the second and third metatarsal

injuries.description: The donor skin was taken from both her thighs which are now as a consequence disfigured.
source: The donor skin was taken from both her thighs which are now as a consequence disfigured.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Repeated breakdowns of the grafted skin
Cornification has also developed which will continue to cause pain in the future
Pain and discomfort when walking continuously for more than 20 to 30 minutes at a time
Now needs to use an orthopaedic shoe
Less able to play with her young children
No longer swims because she is too embarrassed to expose her scars in public
Ability to walk or stand substantially reduced
Cannot operate the zip cutting machine which requires standing

treatments_received: donor skin taken from both thighs (skin grafting)

losses.description: Unsightly appearance of the thighs (donor site scars); plaintiff always wears slacks and is embarrassed by the scars
Unsightly appearance of the left foot (scars and grafted skin on the heel); plaintiff is embarrassed

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: No longer swims and is less able to play with her young children
Reduced ability to walk or stand; can walk comfortably only for 15-30 minutes depending on shoe; requires orthopaedic shoe
Can no longer operate the zip cutting machine (must stand and use left foot for balance); opportunities for factory employment diminished
